title: AKKA ISRAELINI HAYYU WAAQA GAAFATE: HAYYICHA SAULOFI WORRA AMALEKI
paragraphs: Samueliini kha inni jaalaba muumee, jaarani, gumiini Israeli, “Nu akka gosa d’ibii hayyu feena”, isaan jette.

Samueliini waan kan irra ingammanne, ammo Waaqi waan isaan jed’e, “Gumiin Israelii layuu akka hayyu worra na didde. Eegi lafa anin worra lafa Misiriiti baase, worri dudda nati gale waaqota d’ibi waqefate. Tanaafi, waanum worri fed’u sun kenniifi. Ammo gorsa kana worraa kenni, hayyooti worra durdeemtu ch’ufti worra gaargalchite ammalle garboomsiti.”

Ato gorsa kana d’ageetu, gumiin Israeli durumaati deemte hayyu woraana keesati worra durdeemu gaafate. Duuba Waaqi Samueli, gurba khaimticha maqaan Saulo jed’aniit erge, akka inni gumi Israeli durdeemu muudi jed’eeni.

Sauloon Israeli dabsacha kenneefi, nyaapa duri Israeliini Lafa Kakhuu keessa baasu dad’abde ch’ufa inni indabsate. Ammo Sauloon Waaqati hirkachu lakkise, ufiit abdachu jalqabe. Guyya tokko, fula Samueli, kha inni qallu Waaqa akka inni d’ufe woraan durati sorio baasu eegu, obsa d’abe ufiin soorio sun baase. Waaqi guddo dallane.

Guyya d’ibii Waaqi Samueli kees bahe SauLutui dubbate akka inni worra Amaleki had'e halo Israelii baasu. Worri worra waaqota harkaan boch’an kad’atu. Waaqi waan jed’e, “Worra fi hori worraalle ch’ufa hobbaasi.” Ammo Saulofi askartini isaa hayyu nyaapa lubbu baafte, horii gagabbo dadansa ch'ufa hobaasu didani. Akka ufiin ulfeesan.

Samuelini Sauloti d'ufe jennaani Sauloni waan jed'eeni, “Anini dubbi Waaqa ya gula deeme guute.” Ammo Samuelini waan jed'eeni, “Marriti loonitifi ta ree ta anini d'agayu tunini maani re?” Sauloni waan jed'eeni, “Askarti tiyyati worra Amaleki iraa boojie. Worri loonifi hooliye ira gagabbo hambise, aka Waaqa kanketi sorio baasu. Ammo nu hori kaani ch'ufa yayu hobaamne.” Samuelini waan Sauloni jed'e, “Lakisi afaani qabad'i! Waaqi saala fed'a mo waan gubani isaa baasanifi sorio fed'a? Saalfachaani isaa saalfatani gabbinna ilmoole hoola ta isaa sorio baasani kennanifi ira jirti. Diditini isa didani akuma falfala hamtu. Kiyyibi isa durati kiyyibanileeni akuma nama waaqa harkani mid'aasani kad'ate hama. Waan atini dubbi Waaqa diddeefi, innileeni aka atini hayyu tate worra Israeli dura deemtu ya dide.”

Sauloni waan jed'eeni, “Anini yayu ch'ubbu tolche, dubbi Waaqatifi jecha kanketile guutu dide. Anini askarti tiyya sodaad'e dubbi worraa gula bahe. Anini yayu ch'ubbu tolche, ammo hataatuti atini jaarole gosa tiyyatifi worra Israeli ch'ufa durati na inch'eersini na woliini deemi, aka anini Waaqa kad'ad'u.” Duuba Samuelini Saulo woliini deeme, Sauloni Waaqa kad'ate. Ammo Samuelini hayyicha Amaleki nama ch’ufa duraati ijeese, duuba haga achi deeme takka Saulooni wolingarre.
